title: Post-Sale Interest Rate and the Customer's Kestrel Lease — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Deficiencies
content:
Interest for the days after the sale date on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract is figured at a post-sale annual rate that follows the customer's other Kestrel lease, the Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease. Where the customer holds more than one active Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease, the first one the lease lookup lists is the one read; its days past due and its lease payments made decide the rate.

| The customer's active Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease | Post-sale annual rate |
|---|---|
| No days past due and at least 12 lease payments made (the relationship minimum) | the long-relationship share of the contract rate: the contract rate times 0.3 (30 percent) |
| No days past due and fewer than 12 lease payments made | the short-relationship share of the contract rate: the contract rate times 0.6 (60 percent) |
| Any days past due | the contract rate |
| No active Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease | the contract rate |

The post-sale per diem is the principal balance times the post-sale rate divided by the day basis for the tier, rounded to the cent.

### Hypothetical cases (contract rate 12.00 percent)

| Lease shown | Post-sale rate |
|---|---|
| Active, 0 days past due, 12 payments made | 3.60 percent |
| Active, 0 days past due, 11 payments made | 7.20 percent |
| Active, 5 days past due, 30 payments made | 12.00 percent |
| Lease turned in, none active | 12.00 percent |

With a hypothetical principal balance of $8000.00 and a 365-day basis, a post-sale rate of 3.60 percent gives a post-sale per diem of $288.00 divided by 365, $0.789…, rounded to $0.79.
